messages.content: 你能否發送一封電子郵件給我的同事，地址為john.doe@example.com，主題為“項目更新”，內容為“親愛的約翰，項目進展如計劃，我們將按時完成任務。謝謝你，亞歷克斯”，然後把這封信寄送副本給我的經理，地址為manager@example.com，並傳送密件副本給人力資源，地址為hr@example.com？之後，你能否再發送一封電子郵件給我的另一位同事，地址為jane.doe@example.com，主題為“會議提醒”，內容為“親愛的珍妮，這是明天上午10點我們預定的會議提醒。謝謝你，亞歷克斯”，並把這封信寄送副本給我的助理，地址為assistant@example.com，並傳送密件副本給人力資源，地址為hr@example.com？

function.name: send_email
function.description: Send an email to the specified email address. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

to.description: The email address to send to.

body.description: The body content of the email.

cc.description: The email address to carbon copy. default is ''.

bcc.description: The email address to blind carbon copy. the value is set to '' for default.

message.reasoning:
The user wants two emails sent:

1) To john.doe@example.com with cc manager@example.com and bcc hr@example.com.

Subject "项目更新" (Project Update). Body: “亲爱的约翰， 项目进展如计划，我们将按时完成任务，谢谢你，亚历克斯”

2) To jane.doe@example.com with cc assistant@example.com and bcc hr@example.com.

Subject "会议提醒". Body: “亲爱的大姐? Wait it's Chinese: “亲爱的珍妮，这是一...”. Actually they wrote: “亲爱的珍妮，這是明天下午??” Let's read carefully: They said: "親愛的珍妮，這是明天上午10點我們預定的會議提醒。謝謝你，亞歷克斯"

So we need to call the tool twice.

We have no constraints about sending multiple calls; but each call can only handle one email at a time. So we'll do two separate calls.

We'll use the `send_email` function from the defined namespace.

First call:
{
    to:"john.doe@example.com",
    subject:"项目前期更新", wait actual subject: "項目更新"
    body:"親愛的約翰， 項目進展如計劃，我們將按時完成任務。 謝謝你，亞歷克斯"
    cc:"manager@example.com",
    bcc:"hr@example.com"
}

Second call:
{
   to:"jane.doe@example.com",
   subject:"会議提醒",
   body:"親愛的珍妮，這是明天上午10點我們預定的會議提醒。謝謝你，亞歷克斯",
   cc:"assistant@example.com",
   bcc:"hr@example.com"
}

But note: In first email, subject should exactly match what user typed: "項目更新".

In second email, subject: "會議提醒".

Also check if there were any special characters or punctuation differences. Use same as user typed.

Now produce output accordingly. We'll make sure to include correct JSON format.

Let's proceed.
